title: Interfacially synthesized reverse osmosis membrane
lineage: Selected passages paraphrased from the cited text.

passages.note: US 4,277,344 was filed 22 February 1979 and issued 7 July 1981. It describes aromatic polyamide reverse-osmosis membranes synthesized by interfacial polymerization, with the thin separating layer on a porous support in the composite design.
